title: Enrollment Deposit Schedule — Riverbend Self-Pay Maternity & Delivery Package
content:
The enrollment deposit on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery estimate under Good Faith & Price Estimates is settled by this schedule, and only that deposit: the initial deposit on an outpatient surgery package is not figured by it, and on every other package type the deposit paid at scheduling stays the type's deposit percentage of the package price, rounded half-up to the cent.

**(a) Packages owing no enrollment deposit.** A maternity booking whose patient's award covers the expected delivery date and either is at the Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care or Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL) tier, or carries a hardship liability cap with no cap left, owes no enrollment deposit and is outside this schedule. The patient's award is the patient's approved case in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the expected delivery date, which is the scheduled service date, when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

**(b) The enrollment deposit.** The enrollment deposit on a maternity and delivery package is the deposit percentage of the delivery package price, rounded half-up to the cent. The delivery package price is the sum of the Riverbend facility line and the Riverbend professional line that carry the package's principal service code on the current version; co-provider lines are not part of it. The deposit percentage is that of the Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery type in the package deposit schedule.

**(c) Applying the percentage.** The deposit percentage is one figure, settled in full — any percentage points added to it included — before it is applied, and the percentage applied is never more than one hundred percent (100 percent). The product is rounded half-up to the cent once, an exact half cent going up.

| Condition | Enrollment deposit |
|---|---|
| Award covers the expected delivery date and is at either charity care tier named in (a) | none |
| Award covers the expected delivery date and has a hardship cap above zero with no cap left | none |
| Any other package | the deposit percentage of the delivery package price, rounded half-up once |

## Worked figure (hypothetical lines)

Riverbend facility line 7000.00 and Riverbend professional line 2345.67 carry the principal code; an anesthesia co-provider line of 900.00 is left out. Delivery package price 9345.67. Taking the deposit percentage as 25 percent, the product is 2336.4175, and the enrollment deposit is 2336.42.
